market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo is a sitting National Assembly legislator and former governor of the province, making him a likely frontrunner for the Democratic Party nomination. Even with nomination and general-election uncertainty, a true win probability of ~7% is far more realistic than the market's ~0.8%. The large gap justifies a Yes pick despite high uncertainty.
evidence_points: Yang Seung-jo is a two-term lawmaker (currently representing Cheonan) and previously served as province governor (2018-2022), giving him high name recognition.
In South Korean local elections, major-party candidates routinely have base probabilities above 1%, especially former incumbents in swing provinces like Chungcheongnam.
The 2026 election remains distant, but the market price of 0.8% implies an effectively negligible chance, inconsistent with his political standing.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of South Korean politics
Recall of 2018 and 2022 local election results
Awareness of Yang Seung-jo's current MP role
